title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 final zero-event set
notes: Built from fresh canonical main 8a2da43eff09103867267ffeb36f68b74279d6a7 after recalculating coverage gaps. These four records intentionally avoid inferring launch dates. Where an official source only proves existence or feature availability by a documented date, the event uses discovery chronology rather than product_released.

events.title: Begin Wallet integrated Agent T
events.description: Begin Wallet announced on 2025-04-29 that Agent T, its AI-powered crypto advisor, was integrated directly into Begin Wallet, providing on-chain, market, and threat-analysis information inside the wallet.

events.title: Glow documented browser extension and mobile wallet apps
events.description: Glow's official privacy policy dated 2022-05-11 documented glow.app, the Glow browser extension, and Glow mobile apps as operating parts of the service. This is recorded as existence-by-date evidence and does not assert a launch date.

events.title: Petra wallet application and browser extension documented as available services
events.description: Aptos Labs' Petra Wallet Terms dated 2023-12-12 documented the unhosted Petra wallet application and browser extension as services made available to users. This record establishes existence by that date without inferring the product's original launch date.

events.title: VESPR documented in-wallet Cardano buy and sell functionality
events.description: VESPR's official documentation described an in-wallet Buy/Sell feature powered by Topper Pay and stated fee terms effective as of 2024-12-13. The date is used conservatively as documented existence chronology rather than as the feature's launch date.

evidence.title: Introducing Agent T: Your AI-Powered Crypto Advisor in Begin Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Begin Wallet announcement explicitly says Agent T is integrated directly into Begin Wallet.

evidence.title: Privacy Policy
evidence.notes: First-party Glow policy names the website, browser extension, and mobile apps as the service; used only for existence-by-date chronology.

evidence.title: Petra Wallet Terms of Use
evidence.notes: First-party Aptos Labs wallet terms document Petra's wallet application and browser extension; used only for existence-by-date chronology.

evidence.title: Buy/Sell Cardano
evidence.notes: First-party VESPR documentation describes the feature and states fee terms as of 2024-12-13; used conservatively as discovery chronology.
